verdict.rationale: INPI's own service pages give some exact time figures that work as deadlines: renewal every 10 years, patent and utility-model terms of 20 and 10 years kept valid by paying annuities, and design publication deferral of 1 to 30 months. Nothing in the evidence covers penalties, surcharges or interest for missing a deadline, and no fee amounts are given. missing for 10: published penalty/surcharge and interest schedule for missed deadlines, exact fee amounts, annuity due dates and grace periods, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, the filing deadlines and the penalty and interest schedule for missing them are published with exact figures

citations.quote: A duração de uma patente é de 20 anos e a de um modelo de utilidade é de 10 anos... para que se mantenham válidos, é preciso pagar as anuidades correspondentes.
o titular precisa de renovar o registo a cada 10 anos.
A apresentação pode ser adiada por um período de 1 a 30 meses, a contar da data do pedido de registo.
